title: SafeListing: AI fills EU product-safety and packaging data from supplier documents
source: Top 25 SaaS ideas for Victor (research report, Nov 2026)
summary: AI pulls EU product-safety (GPSR) and packaging data out of supplier PDFs, translates the warnings and fills the store and marketplace fields sellers are legally required to show. Existing plugins only add empty fields.
hook: "I have 2,000 products and the law says each one needs manufacturer details and warnings in the buyer's language. The data is buried in supplier PDFs."
story:
**Jan runs a WooCommerce shop in the Netherlands selling toys and home goods** from a dozen suppliers. Since December 2024 the GPSR rules say every listing must show **manufacturer details, an EU responsible person and safety warnings** in the buyer's language. He installed a free plugin, but it only added **empty fields** to 2,000 products.

The real data is in supplier PDFs and safety sheets, in English, German and Chinese. On top of that, from August 2026 he must **register for packaging fees** in each country he ships to. Jan needs a tool that reads the supplier documents, fills the fields, translates the warnings and tracks his registrations.
whyNow: The EU General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR) has applied since 13 December 2024 and requires manufacturer details, an EU responsible person and warnings in the buyer's language on listings. The Packaging Regulation (PPWR) has applied since 12 August 2026, so online sellers must register and pay packaging fees in each country they ship to; a vendor cites German deadlines of 12 September and 12 November 2026.
evidence: GPSR has applied since 13 December 2024 and requires manufacturer details, an EU responsible person and buyer-language warnings on listings [PriceProof]
Shopify does not provide a responsible person, so liability stays with the merchant [Meetanshi]
PPWR has applied since 12 August 2026: online sellers must register and pay packaging fees in each country they ship to [Taxually]
Amazon published a paper in March 2026 on how fragmented EPR packaging registrations are [Amazon]
Enforcement intensity is uncertain: marketplaces reportedly not yet required to check packaging registration numbers, no mass delisting [expan.do]
About 20 Shopify GPSR apps (most with no reviews) and at least 10 WooCommerce GPSR plugins, many free [Shopify App Store / WordPress.org]

sources.title: Amazon: fragmentation in EPR packaging registration (March 2026)

whyReal.title: A clear legal duty
whyReal.text: GPSR (since December 2024) and PPWR (since August 2026) put concrete data and registration duties on online sellers into the EU.

whyReal.title: The data is the hard part
whyReal.text: Existing plugins add empty fields. The work is finding manufacturer and safety data in supplier documents and translating warnings.

whyReal.title: Registrations are fragmented
whyReal.text: Even Amazon wrote a paper about how fragmented packaging registrations are across EU countries.

whyReal.title: Fits Victor's document AI
whyReal.text: It reuses the document-extraction engine and pairs naturally with PriceGuard, since the same suppliers send price lists and safety data.

whoPays.label: Customer
whoPays.text: EU and non-EU merchants selling into the EU on WooCommerce, Shopware or PrestaShop with hundreds of products or more, and the agencies that run their stores.

whoPays.label: Start market
whoPays.text: WooCommerce and Shopware stores in Germany, the Netherlands and Sweden, plus their agencies.

solution.title: Scan the catalogue
solution.text: a WooCommerce plugin finds every product with missing GPSR fields.

solution.title: Upload supplier documents
solution.text: AI extracts manufacturer, responsible person and warnings, with a confidence score.

solution.title: Human review
solution.text: a review queue lets the merchant approve or fix each extraction.

solution.title: Translate and publish
solution.text: warnings are translated and shown in a product-page safety block.

solution.title: Export
solution.text: CSV export, later feeds for Google, eMAG and Allegro.

must: Bulk scan of the catalogue for missing GPSR fields
Supplier-document upload with AI extraction and confidence score
Product-page safety block and CSV export

techStack: OCR + LLM extraction with confidence scores

timeline.what: **Validate, no code.** Post in WooCommerce and Shopware groups offering a free "GPSR gap scan" of up to 1,000 products; measure sign-ups. Run AI extraction by hand on three merchants' supplier PDFs. Ask for $49/month to keep it updated.
Victor builds the plugin, catalogue scan and supplier-document extraction.
Review queue, translation, safety block, CSV export, packaging checklist.
Publish a free plugin on WordPress.org with paid AI credits; convert gap-scan users.
